attributes.action: Require local authorities to have a cooling strategy
attributes.additional_details: Each LA must have a cooling strategy to include free provision of cooling facilities accessible to all. Current access to swimming and other cooling activities is based on ability to pay, which could lead to tragic deaths of young people in particular trying to cool down in increasingly hot weather not of their making. Deaths due to drowning could also be published annually by the LA. We believe mechanisms such as free access to local pools on days above a certain temperature and indoor and outdoor cooling spaces must be introduced. We feel annual death reporting by LAs could encourage action.
attributes.background: We need all local authorities to have a cooling strategy to deal with increasing heat, causing unnecessary deaths from drowning etc. Each Local Authority (LA) must publish its strategy including things like free swimming on heatwave days, and provision of indoor and outdoor cooling facilities.
